title: A Gas Company Found Pipeline Leaks by Following Vultures

scenes.text: A gas company once found its pipeline leaks by following vultures.
In 1938, engineers pumped a smelly chemical into a forty-two-mile gas line and watched the sky.
Turkey vultures gathered over several spots. Every one turned out to be a real leak.
The chemical is also given off by rotting meat, and a turkey vulture can smell it at a few parts per trillion.
A bird that finds dinner by nose turned out to be a leak detector.
No sensor. Just a vulture with one of the best noses in nature.

description:
A gas company once found its pipeline leaks by following vultures.
In 1938 a chemical that smells like rotting meat was pumped into a gas line, and turkey vultures gathered over every real leak.
Could you smell a leak before a vulture does? Comment below.
